fields.label: Email
fields.description: The group's address, e.g. sales@acme.com. Mail sent to it reaches every member. Its domain must be a Mail Domain of the site. Cannot change after saving.

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: Mail Domain the address belongs to. Derived from the email.

fields.label: Site
fields.description: Suite site that owns the group. Derived from the domain; the site's group limit applies.

fields.label: Cluster
fields.description: Cluster the group lives on. Derived from the site.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: What the group is for, e.g. Sales team. Shown on the cluster as the group's name.

fields.label: Disable Receiving
fields.description: Tick to stop the group receiving mail: mail addressed to it bounces back to the sender, while its members' own mail is not affected. Untick to let it receive again.
Stalwart's per-account limits. maxDiskQuota (bytes) is required and defaults to the site's default quota; it counts against the site's total disk quota. The others are optional counts.
fields.label: Quotas
Stalwart ID
fields.description: Id of the group on the cluster. Set when it is created there.

fields.label: Aliases
fields.description: Other addresses delivered to the group. Each must be unique across the cluster and under one of the site's domains.
